page: Vultr voc-g-8c-32gb-160s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical AMD EPYC cores running at 2.0 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, featuring 32.0 GB of system memory, which provides 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is provided by a 160 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. There are no hardware GPU accelerators bundled with this server.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core testing placing it in the top 25% of its class. Multi-core CPU performance, Passmark CPU scores, and memory bandwidth metrics consistently fall within the average range. The local NVMe storage and balanced memory configuration support steady database operations and static web serving throughput, though prompt processing for larger workloads like 7B LLM models shows weaker performance.

This hardware profile offers a balanced resource density suitable for general-purpose workloads, web serving, and database hosting. The dedicated AMD EPYC cores ensure predictable compute performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core instances, making it a cost-efficient option for production environments requiring stable CPU and NVMe storage performance.
